high.title: Market Awaits Itaú (ITUB4); Ibovespa in Dollar Terms Rises More Than 1% Today (05)
high.summary: The Ibovespa posted significant gains of over 1% when measured in USD terms, indicating either strong equity performance or BRL weakness against the dollar. The market focus is on Q1 2026 earnings season, particularly Itaú's results (ITUB4), Brazil's largest private bank. Analysts expect a weaker quarter due to seasonality effects, reduced credit activity, and the impact of early dividend payments that reduced available capital. Net interest income is also expected to decline due to fewer business days and lower revolving credit line usage, though trading revenues may provide some offset. Despite these headwinds, profit is projected between R$12-12.7 billion with annual growth and ROE near 24%. The bank maintains its strong market position with high profitability and robust dividend distribution capacity. Other major earnings releases include Ambev (ABEV3), Tim (TIMS3), and Prio (PRIO3). The USD-denominated Ibovespa gain suggests either equity strength or currency weakness - both critical for international investors positioning in Brazilian assets.
